title: Score hit the maximum (366/366) around turn 466, roughly 64 turns before the actual ending, while four entire named holds (Emberfall, the Saltkerns, Hollowbrook) and at least one Free Company hub (Gullhaven) were never visited. Nothing signals that huge parts of the world remain unseen once the score caps out, so a completionist could easily read '366/366' as 'I've seen it all.'
